family.description: This entry represents a conserved repeated domain found twice in FAZ1 from Trypanosoma brucei and similar sequences from trypanosomatids [[cite:PUB00155625]]. This domain is found near the central region and at the very C-terminal of FAZ1. At least 50% of the T. cruzi genome is repetitive sequence, consisting mostly of large gene families of surface proteins, retrotransposons, and subtelomeric repeats [[cite:PUB00155626]].
family.name: FAZ1, conserved domain
